responsibility: Emits the `rustc_outlives` debugging output for annotated HIR items by querying each item's inferred outlives predicates, formatting the inferred type- and region-outlives clauses, and reporting them as diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `collect/dump.rs` and `variance/dump.rs`, this dump file reports inferred outlives predicates for annotated items by querying `inferred_outlives_of`, focusing specifically on lifetime/type outlives results rather than general collected metadata or variance output.
